create_dist: create a Dirichlet or Categorical distribution for anchor weights given a dist_type and number of anchors
create_LinearSubspace: create a LinearSubspace module with N anchor linear layers that blend outputs via alpha weights
test_LinearSubspace_forward: test the LinearSubspace forward pass by passing input tensor x and mixing coefficients alpha
add_LinearSubspace_anchor: add a new anchor to a LinearSubspace as a convex combination of existing anchors using alpha weights
compute_LinearSubspace_L2_norms: compute pairwise L2 norms between all anchor weight matrices in a LinearSubspace module
